hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo 'SessionStart re-check, run before NEXT.md is read:' && { GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch -q origin || echo 'git fetch failed: the counts below are against the last fetch'; } && git status -sb && { u=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{upstream}' 2>/dev/null) && echo "behind, unpushed against $u: $(git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD')" || echo 'this branch has no upstream: behind and unpushed not counted'; } && grep -m1 '^Updated' NEXT.md
echo 'The conversation was compacted. Re-read NEXT.md, DECISIONS.md and TRAPS.md before acting on anything.'

grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc][[:space:]]+(\\\"[^\\]*\\\"|[^[:space:]]+)|-[^[:space:]]+))*[[:space:]]+push([^[:alnum:]_.-]|$)' && { echo 'Blocked by the project hook: never push. The owner pushes.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

echo 'Keep in the summary: the item in progress and its state; anything shown to the owner and not yet approved, with its text; anything approved and not yet applied or committed. Say that NEXT.md, DECISIONS.md and TRAPS.md must be re-read before acting.'
